comment: Digest refreshed after source-record helper namespace update; field classifications preserved.

EstimatedRecommendationModel.estimatedUt.reason: Primitive estimated utility matrix in the paper-facing estimated recommendation model.

EstimatedRecommendationModel.trueModel.reason: Container pointer to the underlying recommendation model; the nested RecommendationModel.utility field is audited separately as the primitive source utility matrix.

RecommendationModel.utility.reason: Primitive source utility matrix for users and items.

ReductionWitness.data.reason: Container pointer to the symmetric source data; the nested model, type assignment, and within-type agreement fields are audited separately.

ReductionWitness.reduced.reason: Container pointer to the reduced type-weighted model; its utility and weight fields are audited separately and are not treated as independent hidden source assumptions.

ReductionWitness.utility_agrees.reason: Definition-level reduction equality connecting the source utility matrix to the reduced type utility; it is a derivation/bridge condition, not a standalone source assumption.

ReductionWitness.weight_eq_typeWeight.reason: Definition-level reduction equality identifying reduced weights with source type counts; it is a derivation/bridge condition, not a standalone source assumption.

SymmetricData.agreeWithinTypes.reason: Paper-facing symmetry condition: users in the same type have the same utility vector.

SymmetricData.model.reason: Container pointer to the source recommendation model; RecommendationModel.utility is audited separately as the primitive source utility matrix.

SymmetricData.types.reason: Primitive type assignment used to state the paper's type-symmetry reduction.

TypeWeightedRecommendationModel.utility.reason: Reduced type utility obtained from the source utility matrix and type assignment; the audit treats it as a derived bridge field rather than an independent paper assumption.

TypeWeightedRecommendationModel.weight.reason: Reduced type weight obtained from source type counts; the audit treats it as a derived bridge field rather than an independent paper assumption.
